data.title: Cardano Founder Slams Ethereum's Governance, Says Crypto Needs 'Insurance' To Grow Up
data.description: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson says the next phase of cryptocurrency adoption will be driven less by faster blockchains and more by safety, governance and consumer protections. Ethereum ‘Keeps Doing Things Wrong’ In an interview with CoinDesk on July 23, Hoskinson,...
